Parameters of an analysis project

Source: R/analysis_project.R
analysis_params.Rd

The settings of every step of the analysis written by write_analysis_project() (and chosen in launch_intrait_analyses()), with their defaults. They end up, commented, in the project's utils/parameters.R, the one place where they are read.

Usage

analysis_params(...)

Arguments

...

Values replacing the defaults, by name: seed, min_n, species, sites, sources, ratios, impute, orientation, geometry, scale_cm, scale_action, no_caudal_fin, ventral_mouth, no_pectoral_fin, ts_axes, ts_remove_outliers, ts_style, disparity_iter, pf_style, pf_itv_reference, pf_arrows, itv_nested, acc_metric, acc_n_perm, acc_conv_tol, acc_asymptote, shape, shape_remove_outliers, shape_style, shape_disparity_iter, fig_width_mm, fig_height_mm, fig_dpi.

Value

A named list.

Examples

str(analysis_params(min_n = 10, acc_n_perm = 49))
#> List of 33
#>  $ seed                 : int 16
#>  $ min_n                : num 10
#>  $ species              : NULL
#>  $ sites                : NULL
#>  $ sources              : NULL
#>  $ ratios               : chr [1:9] "BEl" "VEp" "REs" "OGp" ...
#>  $ impute               : logi FALSE
#>  $ orientation          : logi FALSE
#>  $ geometry             : logi FALSE
#>  $ scale_cm             : num 1
#>  $ scale_action         : chr "pixels"
#>  $ no_caudal_fin        : logi FALSE
#>  $ ventral_mouth        : logi FALSE
#>  $ no_pectoral_fin      : logi FALSE
#>  $ ts_axes              : int [1:2] 1 2
#>  $ ts_remove_outliers   : logi FALSE
#>  $ ts_style             : chr "spider"
#>  $ disparity_iter       : int 999
#>  $ pf_style             : chr "hull"
#>  $ pf_itv_reference     : logi TRUE
#>  $ pf_arrows            : logi FALSE
#>  $ itv_nested           : chr "site"
#>  $ acc_metric           : chr "variance"
#>  $ acc_n_perm           : num 49
#>  $ acc_conv_tol         : num 0.05
#>  $ acc_asymptote        : num 0.95
#>  $ shape                : logi TRUE
#>  $ shape_remove_outliers: logi FALSE
#>  $ shape_style          : chr "spider"
#>  $ shape_disparity_iter : int 999
#>  $ fig_width_mm         : num 180
#>  $ fig_height_mm        : num 140
#>  $ fig_dpi              : int 300
